_meta.criticalOrderingWarning: site.branches[0] is CHIKKADPALLY but site.phones[0] is BOWENPALLY. The two arrays are in DIFFERENT orders. Nine UI call sites use phones[0]. Deriving phones from branches naively would silently reorder the site.
